steps.text: Learn the Stormwind flight path from Dungar Longdrink if you don't have it yet
steps.tip: Dwarves and Gnomes arrive on the Deeprun Tram, Night Elves on the Auberdine boat. You need this flight path later in the pack. Skyborne on the balanced route: Exploring the Alliance stays in your log; finish the capital tour whenever you pass through Ironforge and Darnassus.

steps.text: Take the road east through Elwynn into Redridge. Accept Encroaching Gnolls from Guard Parker at the bridge
steps.tip: Follow the road from Goldshire east past Stone Cairn Lake; Guard Parker stands where it crosses into Redridge.
Show of Force is new in Forever. Its Spiked Collars drop from the thrashers right next to the mongrels.

steps.speed: Grab the flight path now; the Stormwind errand later is a flight, not a walk.

steps.tip: A Free Lunch goes back to Guard Parker; you pass him on the gnoll loop, so it costs almost nothing.
Keep the goulash objectives in mind all pack: snouts by the lake, condors east of it, spider meat in the southwest.
Messenger to Stormwind pairs with The Price of Shoes: one flight covers both.

steps.text: Dig in the Glinting Mud along the shore by the dock for Hilary's Necklace
steps.tip: Several mud piles spawn along the water east of the dock; check them all, only one holds the necklace.
Mongrels roam the hills south of the Lakeshire bridge; pull them one at a time.

steps.speed: Poachers stand in pairs by their camps; use line of sight to split them.

steps.text: Kill Tarantulas south of the Three Corners road for Crisp Spider Meat
steps.speed: Only if Tarantulas are on your path; the Greater Tarantulas at Alther's Mill drop the same meat later.

steps.text: Swim to the Sunken Chest on the lake bed and take Oslow's Toolbox
steps.tip: The chest sits deep; take a breath at the surface first if a murloc chases you down.

steps.text: Kill Great Goretusks on the south shore for 5 Great Goretusk Snouts
Kill murlocs along the east shore of the lake for 10 Spotted Sunfish
steps.speed: Pull murlocs to the shore edge; they run when hurt and bring friends.

steps.text: Kill Dire Condors in the hills east of the lake for 5 Tough Condor Meat
Back in Lakeshire, turn in Hilary's Necklace to Hilary on the dock

steps.speed: If one goulash part is missing, finish it at Alther's Mill and hand in later.
Use the flight time to set up talents or bags.

steps.text: Walk out to Goldshire. Turn in The Price of Shoes to Smith Argus and accept Return to Verner

steps.tip: Hearth back; it is set in Lakeshire.

steps.text: Accept Blackrock Menace and Blackrock Blockade from Marshal Marris
steps.tip: Battleworn Axes drop from the orcs just east of Alther's Mill. The Blockade camp is in the far southeast; balanced only.

steps.text: North of Lakeshire, kill Redridge Brutes and Mystics; collect 5 Iron Pikes and 5 Iron Rivets from the gnolls
steps.tip: Both quests use the same gnoll camp, so do them together.

steps.speed: Skip Howling in the Hills (Yowler is level 25).

steps.text: At Alther's Mill, kill 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs
steps.tip: New in Forever. The mill area is packed with spiders, so move through it slowly.

steps.text: Kill Blackrock Renegades east of Alther's Mill for 10 Battleworn Axes
steps.tip: Renegades are level 21-22: pull singles from the camp edge.

steps.text: Kill Black Dragon Whelps south of the lake for 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales
steps.speed: Whelps sit in groups; burn one, then line of sight the rest.

steps.text: In the southeast orc camp, loot 8 Stolen Weapons from the weapon racks and 10 Blackrock Supplies
steps.tip: New in Forever. The racks and supply piles are objects; loot them between pulls and avoid the camp centre.
Bellygrub is a level 24 boar west of Lakeshire. Skip it below 20 unless you have a partner or a strong pet.

steps.text: Grind murlocs on the east shore of Lake Everstill to level 20
steps.speed: Murlocs on the east shore are the densest camp near Lakeshire. Grind them to 20, then head to Duskwood or Wetlands for 20-30.

steps.text: If you are not yet 20, grind murlocs on the east shore of Lake Everstill
steps.tip: Once you are 20, Murloc Poachers from Dockmaster Baren uses the same murlocs.
Next for 20-30: Duskwood (walk west through Three Corners to Darkshire) or Wetlands via Menethil Harbor.
